apps.localizedDescription:
Erosion-CN 是面向 iOS / iPadOS 27.0–27.2.1 & 27.3 beta 1（及 26.x 部分功能）的中英双语系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（防白苹果安全加固版）。

• 原位覆盖写入（pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC）与写后全量读回校验，杜绝重启反弹与 0 字节白苹果
• 无损 CoreFoundation 类型直通，根治相机取景黑屏
• 运行时动态解析 libMobileGestalt.dylib 槽位 + 双金库 SHA-256 备份一键恢复原厂
• 支持国行 Apple 智能解锁、海外 eSIM 与 FaceTime 音频开启、应用存档备份、缓存清理与电池/崩溃诊断

⚠️ 签名要求：安装时请务必保留 App Group 权限（SideStore / AltStore / Feather 默认支持）。

Bilingual (English + Simplified Chinese) bootloop-hardened MobileGestalt & cross-container research toolkit for iOS/iPadOS 27.x. Requires at least one App Group entitlement when signing.

## Erosion-CN v1.0.0 (Build 25) — Milestone Release

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility Notice / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Full MobileGestalt & Container Support**: `iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`). (**`iOS 27.2.1` is recommended** for full generative Apple Intelligence features on CH/A hardware.)  
> - **Patched in `iOS 27.3 beta 2+` (`24C5049d+`)**: Apple patched `worse_query` starting in `27.3 beta 2`. Version `v1.0.0` detects patched builds automatically and displays clear diagnostics instead of failing silently.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **APFS `clonefile()` Zero-Space App Swap Vault (5-Layer Foolproofing) / APFS 零空间换包暂存舱（五重防呆）**
   - Stage & restore tens of GBs of app data (`Documents`, `Library/Application Support`, `Library/Preferences`) via kernel Copy-on-Write (`clonefile`) in seconds with near-zero extra disk usage (`AppDataBackupView` / `APFSStagingVault`).
   - **5 Safety Layers**:
     1. `embedded.mobileprovision` remaining signing validity gate (< 24h warning before staging/uninstalling).
     2. Active 10-second SQLite WAL lock check (`*-wal`) prompting to close the target app first.
     3. Copy-never-move `clonefile()` staging + WeChat `<32-hex>` MD5 account folder detection.
     4. `manifest.json` file-count & byte-size integrity verification.
     5. Atomic `.erosion_pre_restore_bak` swap with auto-rollback, cross-Bundle-ID `.plist` adaptation, Staging Vault retention until verified, screen-awake lock, and a persistent Home banner warning against uninstalling while data is staged.

2. **Wi-Fi HTTP File Sharing / Wi-Fi 局域网网页互传**
   - Browse folders, download individual files or `.zip` folder archives (up to 2 GB), and drag-and-drop multi-file uploads (`PUT /api/upload` streaming in 64 KB chunks to `.part` files) from any browser on the same Wi-Fi (`WiFiShareServer`).
   - Protected by per-session random 6-digit PIN HTTP Basic Auth (`erosion`), strict non-destructive collision auto-renaming (`name 2.ext`, never overwrites/deletes), and auto-stop on dismiss or background.

3. **Deep Folder Search, Top 100 Largest Files, Recent & Go to Path / 深度搜索、百大文件雷达与路径直达**
   - Async cancellable recursive subfolder search (capped at 500 matches) + fast `fstatat` Top 100 largest files analyzer (`FolderAnalysisSheet`).
   - Records up to 15 recently opened folders (`Recent`) and adds clipboard-aware `Go to Path…` (`/var/` / `/private/var/`) in File Browser (`FMRootView`).

4. **POSIX File/Folder Permission Editor (`chmod`) / 文件与文件夹 POSIX 权限修改 ([#48](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/48))**
   - Inside `InfoViewer` (`Show Info` / `显示简介`), safely modify permissions for user app data & App Group subpaths (strictly blocks container roots, `SystemGroup`, `Bundle`, `InternalDaemon`, `System`, symlinks, and non-`mobile` owners): one-tap **Read-Only (`0555`/`0444`)**, **Restore Read-Write (`0755`/`0644`)**, or custom `u/g/o` bits with `lstat` verification.

5. **Faster Cache Cleaner + Selection Menu / 缓存清理提速与选择菜单**
   - `.userInitiated` scanning, `deniedContainers` skip cache, fast POSIX `opendir`/`readdir`/`fstatat` sizing, live scan counter + **Stop** button, and **Select (`All` / `Invert` / `None`)** menu (`CacheCleanerView`).

6. **`iOS 27.3 beta 2+` Patched Sentinel, `27.3 beta 1` Notice & `LiveContainer` Diagnostics / 27.3 分版本守卫与 LiveContainer 只读诊断**
   - Distinguishes `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`) from `27.3 beta 2+` (`24C5049d+`), explains `-5`/`-6` sandbox denials on patched builds, adds a Home warning banner on patched OS, and shows a read-only `eligibilityd` CH/A notice on `27.3 beta 1`.
   - Detects read-only `LiveContainer` (`LC_HOME_PATH`) execution and surfaces guidance in startup logs, Home card, and authorization errors to check host App Group settings in LiveContainer or install standalone.

> 📜 Full bilingual technical changelog (简体中文 & English): **[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)**

---

### Credits / 开源致谢
- Core `MobileGestalt` write engine remains unchanged and bootloop-hardened (`pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC`, lossless plist types, dual-vault SHA-256 restore).
- Additional GPLv3 references in `v1.0.0`: **[kolbicz / WQFiles](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles)** and **[yangokok886 / WCMigrate](https://github.com/yangokok886/WCMigrate)**.

## Erosion-CN v0.9.1 更新日志 · Bilingual Release Notes (Build 23)

### 🇨🇳 简体中文

#### 🛠️ 关键 Bug 修复：原生 AI 机型 `Personal Translator (#266)` 基线锁定与双向自愈（修复 #16 / #22）
1. **修复旧版（`v0.8.3 – v0.8.5`）误关槽位 `#266` 导致相册云端工具与相机 Siri「0 秒瞬间报错」的问题**：
   - 在所有原生支持 Apple 智能的 iPhone（`iPhone 15 Pro` 至 `iPhone 18 Pro Max` 全系列）原厂 `CacheData` 中，`Personal Translator`（`M1n2sAqf33NAOgZRGxQYBA`，槽位 `#266`）原厂默认为 `true (0x01)`，而 `Audio Intelligence`（`rb2tKZxlj0Gm2tBmUQSLqQ`，槽位 `#178`）原厂默认为 `false (0x00)`。
   - 此前跨 iOS 版本 OTA 升级（旧 `OriginalGestalt.plist` 的 `CacheUUID` 变化）或非 18 Pro 机型执行一键配齐时，可能将 `#266` 误写为 `false (0x00)` 并污染本地 `UserDefaults` 基线快照，触发 `GenerativeModels / ModelCatalog` 本地预检 0ms 熔断报错（端侧快速消除正常，但**照片高质量消除、扩图延伸、重构及相机 `SIRI` 模式**瞬间报错）。
   - `v0.9.1` 已锁定全系原生 AI iPhone 的硬件原厂基线（`#266 = true`、`#178 = false`，免疫跨版本备份不匹配与污染缓存），并在恢复出厂 / 重建缓存 / 重生备份时自动清理本地槽位基线记录。
2. **新增双向异常检测与「一键配齐 / 修复」自愈提示**：
   - 顶部「Apple 智能激活四要素体检」卡片、实时 `MGCopyAnswer` 核验与防呆护栏现可**双向检测**槽位偏移（无论 `#178` 被强开为 `true` 还是原生 AI 机型的 `#266` 被误关为 `false`）；
   - 受旧版影响的用户升级 `v0.9.1` 后，打开 `MobileGestalt` 点击顶部 **「一键配齐 / 修复」→「应用」→ 手动关机冷重启** 即可完整恢复原厂基线。
3. **单包中英双语同步更新**：新增诊断提示词条已 100% 同步内置简体中文 (`zh-Hans`) 与英文 (`en`) 双语翻译。

---

### 🌐 English

#### 🛠️ Critical Bug Fix: `Personal Translator (#266)` Factory Baseline Lock & Two-Way Auto-Heal (Fixes #16 / #22)
1. **Fixed instant 0ms failure in Photos Cloud Tools (High-Quality Clean Up / Extend / Reframe) & Camera `SIRI` caused by slot `#266` downgrade**:
   - On all native Apple Intelligence iPhones (`iPhone 15 Pro` through `iPhone 18 Pro Max`), factory `CacheData` sets `Personal Translator` (`M1n2sAqf33NAOgZRGxQYBA`, slot `#266`) to `true (0x01)` and `Audio Intelligence` (`rb2tKZxlj0Gm2tBmUQSLqQ`, slot `#178`) to `false (0x00)`.
   - Earlier versions (`v0.8.3 – v0.8.5`) could accidentally flip slot `#266` to `false (0x00)` on non-18-Pro models or after an OTA iOS update (`CacheUUID` change) and cache that polluted baseline in `UserDefaults`, causing `GenerativeModels / ModelCatalog` to abort locally in 0ms while Fast Clean Up still worked.
   - `v0.9.1` enforces the verified hardware factory baseline (`#266 = true`, `#178 = false`) across all native AI iPhones and purges stale `UserDefaults` slot baselines on Factory Restore / Clean Cache Rebuild / Backup Regeneration.
2. **Two-Way Slot Drift Detection & One-Click Auto-Heal**:
   - Both the 4-Factor Readiness Checkup Card and live `MGCopyAnswer` verification now detect drift in **both directions** (`#178` forced ON or `#266` accidentally turned OFF on native AI hardware) and expose **One-Click Setup / Repair** immediately.
   - To heal an affected device: install `v0.9.1` → open **Tweaks → MobileGestalt** → tap **One-Click Setup / Repair** → **Apply** → **power off and cold-reboot**.

## Erosion-CN v0.8.6 更新日志 (Build 21)

### 🚀 容器极速枚举修复 & 空间音频硬件防呆解耦 & 分流规则增强

1. **修复高 Inode 主力机容器扫描卡死 5–6 分钟，并适配 `iOS 26.3.x` `CSStore2` 秒开（修复 #21）**：
   - **修正 `pathleak` 上限保护逻辑**：修复长期使用的设备（累计 APFS 单调递增 Inode 超过 2 亿）在回退 `pathleak` 时外层 `min/max` 写反导致 `15,000,000` 上限失效、强行遍历 2.28 亿次系统调用的问题；
   - **新增不依赖结构体偏移的 `CSStore2` 书签 TLV（`NSURL minimalBookmark`）兜底提取引擎**：在 `iOS 26.3.x` 与 `iOS 27.x` 上均可直接从 `.csstore` 提取并校验有效的应用数据（`Application`）、扩展插件（`PluginKitPlugin`）、应用共享组（`AppGroup`）与守护进程（`InternalDaemon`）容器路径，无论容器 Inode 高低均可秒级加载。

2. **拆分「FaceTime 空间音频」与「空间音频录制」，新增非四麦克风机型自动防呆（修复 #19）**：
   - 将原合并开关拆分为独立的 **「FaceTime 空间音频」**（`spatial-facetime-audio`，纯软件声场渲染，兼容 `iPhone 15 Pro` 及更早机型）与 **「空间音频录制（相机 / 语音备忘录录音室）」**（`spatial-audio-recording`）；
   - 对非四麦克风阵列旧机型（`iPhone 15` 系列及更早三麦克风机型）默认自动防呆锁定关闭「空间音频录制」，避免语音备忘录出现无效的「录音室 (Studio)」档位并点录音即停（旧版已开启用户升级后可直接一键关闭恢复）。

3. **修正屏幕子类型 (Subtype) 数值与多项交互提示优化（#14 / #15 / #17 / #13）**：
   - 修正上游遗留的「屏幕子类型」数值笔误（`iPhone 14 Pro / 15 Pro` 修正为 `2556`，`iPhone 14 Pro Max / 15 Pro Max` 修正为 `2796`）并消除重复 Tag 冲突；

### 🛠️ 照片「高质量」消除防冲突锁定 & iPhone 18 Pro 系列原厂基线精准保护

1. **修复开启「解锁 iOS 27 进阶 AI 能力 `[测试特性]`」导致照片「高质量」消除报错的问题**：
   - 经 `iPhone 18 Pro Max (iPhone19,7)` 真机 A/B 对照与 `MGInspector` 三源底层探针实锤确认：
